svg.title: From workload to a session host VM: four steps
svg.desc: Step 1: know the workload (light, medium, heavy or power; single-session or multi-session). Step 2: choose the VM, which means size, optional GPU, OS disk and security type. Step 3: quota and capacity can stop a deployment, so check both. If the deployment fails, go back to step 2 and change size, zone or region, or request quota. If it passes, the VM is created. Step 4: after it runs, measure with AVD Insights, tune with autoscale, and save money with savings plans and reserved instances.
svg.text: From workload to a session host VM: four steps
4. After it runs: measure, tune and save money
watch CPU, memory, delay; resize if needed
lower the price if you commit for a set time
